name: bits-base-v2-mars-jupiter-pilot-v1
research_question: Test whether a deliberately small, executable semantic language (base-v2, 53 words / 43 predictor labels, fully costed across operations, bindings, structure, constants and types) makes it easier for a bounded non-autoregressive learner (TypedPredictor) to construct correct programs for unfamiliar problems under explicit training and inference budgets, measuring expressibility, discoverability, unfamiliar combinations and unfamiliar families separately.

jupiter.pre_launch_gate: Verify Jupiter /usr/bin/bwrap and /usr/bin/prlimit sandbox controls (findings/semantic-target-native-v1/verify.py) and GPU/CPU compute readiness before any corpus qualification or training run.
jupiter.sandbox_policy: unchanged repository Linux bwrap/prlimit judge only; no macOS or unsandboxed execution fallback

authorization_boundary.gamma_policy: gamma/AGENTS.md: Model downloads, remote providers, and compute jobs require user authority.
authorization_boundary.recorded_november_9_exception_scope: literals/macro-fragment-compare-v1/CONTRACT.md authorizes resuming only the macro/fragment literal representation comparison over 300+100 KnownSpecService sources; it does not automatically authorize a new teacher-generated corpus, dataset/encoder downloads, or TypedPredictor training.

required_separate_authorizations.dataset_provisioning: Authorized AllowlistDatasetAdapter access on Jupiter to pinned LeetCodeDataset-train.jsonl (revision 215604aeed660029df7de2fea5a4d7b6ed476a08, 93643427 bytes, sha256 ef7d64d34b092859607c1010bdd23540860a8cfff2ed7aeb0fe82e0ad524919b), enforcing the frozen allowlist before exposing payloads.
required_separate_authorizations.encoder_provisioning_and_embeddings: Authorized Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B weights and embedding compute on Jupiter (revision 97b0c614be4d77ee51c0cef4e5f07c00f9eb65b3, model.safetensors 1191586416 bytes sha256 0437e45c94563b09e13cb7a64478fc406947a93cb34a7e05870fc8dcd48e23fd, tokenizer.json 11423705 bytes sha256 def76fb086971c7867b829c23a26261e38d9d74e02139253b38aeb9df8b4b50a).
required_separate_authorizations.isolated_teacher_inference: Separately authorized isolated offline teacher with pinned model_id, model_revision, prompt_sha256, and max_proposals <= 4 receiving only _public_input (statement, starter_code, params, public_examples) and zero reference solutions, independent tests, or judge verdicts.
required_separate_authorizations.student_training_and_evaluation: Authorized single bounded non-autoregressive TypedPredictor training run and matched 4-route evaluation on Jupiter.

exclusion_rules: Explicit allowlist seeded strictly from previously_authorized_400 == literals/cost-decomposition-v1 300 dev_fit + 100 dev_val.

Exclude all 4,744 non-allowlisted PROBLEM_INDEX rows (historical_reserved382, final100_exact_id_reserved, known_corpus_nonreserved_pending_independent_review, unresolved_global_identity_alias_metadata_only, outside-4081-freeze, hack2hire-public-preview).

Exclude all reservations in sample_manifest.json, typed_confirmation_v1.json (66-entry pool plus 8 development_audit identities), js_corpus_reservations_v1.json (waves W001 and W002), and approved-library.json protected_composition_alias entries.
Transitively exclude every connected component across aliases, semantic families, slug sibling_base stems, and group_id structural groups touching any excluded or reserved entry.

representation_boundary.vector_v1_boundary: 57-entry vector-v1 adds three vector effects and one vector type not expressible by the 43-label base-v2 predictor; typed_stream_contract rejects incompatible conversion instead of coercing schemas.

complete_cost_accounting.note: 6-, 7- and 8-bit encodings of the same semantic vocabulary share identical operations; widening token IDs alone is not a comparison of richer 64-, 128- and 256-operation languages.

splits.development_fit: Fitting components within the 175 allowlisted functional dev_fit pool not assigned to heldout_family or heldout_combination; sole partition eligible for offline teacher target construction and student loss/retrieval.
splits.heldout_combination: Predeclared fitting UIDs (--recombination-uid) inside seen semantic families where each family retains >= 1 development_fit example; tests unfamiliar combinations of seen operations/motifs without opening payloads during target construction.
splits.heldout_family: Predeclared semantic family components (--holdout-family, taken from reviewed families within the 61 allowlisted functional dev_val pool and selected disjoint families); tests genuinely unfamiliar problem families with zero family, sibling-stem, alias or structural-group overlap.
splits.excluded_unallowlisted: Any non-allowlisted entry or connected component touching a non-allowlisted alias/family/structure; never opened.
splits.excluded_existing: Any existing protected solving, recognition, confirmation, JS wave, or alias reservation component; takes highest precedence and is never opened.

measured_quantities: expressibility: fraction of reviewed development_fit problems admitting a sandbox-qualified base-v2 program passing public tests, independent tests, and declared_bound_probe (with explicit denominators and unsupported_requirements abstentions preserved)
discoverability_fit: student and comparator pass rates on development_fit under matched inference budgets
transfer_unfamiliar_combinations: pass rates on heldout_combination (public decision sealed before independent-test scoring)
transfer_unfamiliar_families: pass rates on heldout_family (public decision sealed before independent-test scoring)
complete_costs: operations, bindings, structure, constants, types, wall time, model forward count, repair/search candidates, retries, and sandbox verifications

student_configuration.checkpoint_selection: fixed final step only; no validation sweep, early stopping, or holdout-driven retries
student_configuration.loss: minimum qualified graph loss per development_fit problem; heldout_combination, heldout_family, and independent tests excluded from loss and retrieval

matched_routes.description: Single parallel non-autoregressive forward pass of TypedPredictor without structural repair or public-example reranking.
Bounded structural repair and public-example selection over TypedPredictor logits within the frozen 2.0s decision budget.
Retrieval-only comparator selecting the nearest compatible development_fit graph without neural composition.
Non-neural bounded example-conditioned BITS search comparator under the identical 2.0s wall budget and public-example ceiling.
